results.title: 387 Players Set for Second Stage of SBI Life Maharashtra State Schools Chess Championship
results.description: Mumbai : A total of 387 players will compete in the second stage of the SBI Life Maharashtra State Schools Chess Championship 2026, commencing on Friday, November 13, at Rustomjee Cambridge International School, Dahisar (West), Mumbai.
